Why reasoning-unit queries help

Reasoning-unit queries can improve multi-hop retrieval because they replace one overloaded question with smaller queries that match its intermediate information needs. A retriever can then search for each missing fact independently. In your oracle experiment, supporting-fact recall rose from 0.542 with sentence retrieval to 0.917 with ideal reasoning units.

✦ What this does—and does not—show
Better intermediate representations could unlock retrieval quality. It does not yet prove that an automatic generator can reliably create them.
